description: US electric grid monitor from EIA's Hourly Electric Grid Monitor (Form EIA-930, official Open Data API): hourly demand, day-ahead demand forecast, net generation and net interchange for a balancing authority or region (CISO, ERCO, PJM, MISO, NYIS, ISNE, SWPP, US48…), plus the generation mix by fuel (gas, coal, nuclear, wind, solar, hydro…) for the latest reported hour. Times are UTC; values in MWh per hour. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

respondent.description: EIA-930 respondent code: US48, CISO, ERCO, PJM, MISO, NYIS, ISNE, SWPP, SOCO, TVA, BPAT, FPL… (default US48)
